sn35.1:1.1: The “interior” (_ajjhatta_, also _ajjhattika_) of the title is the “interior” aspect of the sense fields, namely the sensory organs, as opposed to the sense stimuli, which are “exterior” (_bāhira_). This is subtly different from the more common pair _ajjhatta_ and _bahiddha_ (internal/external), which refer to what is inside as opposed to what is outside. For example, the eye of someone else is “interior” (_ajjhattika_) but “external” (_bahiddha_). On the other hand, the sound of one’s own voice is “internal” (_ajjhatta_) but “exterior” (_bāhira_).
